plan.title: Control-plane consolidation (bounded contexts, contracts, single-owner guards)
plan.goal: One owner per decision, enforced on the existing system-state-authorities registry and checker; adopt-vs-build on explicit criteria with sunsets
success_criteria: Each declared decision maps to one owner in the five contexts (K1-K5) and nine aggregates (A1-A9)
A new non-owner mutation of an owned decision fails tier0 or its runtime control, with a negative test
No component is replaced without retiring the old one; every spike has a sunset

phases.name: MVP: S0, S1, S2, S1b, S4, S3, S12
phases.goal: Guards on the existing registry, derived independence, durable landing, per-model availability, single routing owner, exit audit

phases.name: Follow-on (after the feature freeze exits)
phases.goal: Deploy, health, branch lock, memory, loops, shims, learning

items.name: Confirm rev 4, verify claims, decide D0–D10
items.goal: Exact-subject independent confirmation and owner freeze

items.name: Existing registry and required static CI guard
items.validation_goal: Real staged and required-CI refusals plus fixture suite

items.name: Shared v3 admission and grant contract
items.goal: Authenticated review and provenance; exact protected merge group gate; reservation
items.validation_goal: Protected success; stale and same-tree races, forgery, replay and permission refusals

items.name: Durable runner using the S2 contract
items.goal: Reconcile one exact response; hold on ambiguity; preserve bot-PR edits separately
items.validation_goal: Real crash, fencing, expiry, revocation and retry cases

items.name: Per-model availability API (A2, DO-4)
items.validation_goal: Real refusal and healthy sibling admitted; QA, dashboard and hold

items.name: Routing owner: schema, ResolvedRunPlan, route-policy module (A1, DO-1)
items.goal: Coordinator owns selection; switchboard executes; migrate readers and hardcoded dicts
items.validation_goal: Real route receipt and forbidden resolved route denied at admission

items.name: MVP exit audit
items.goal: Independent code and runtime review, adversarial pass, fact-sheet re-run

items.name: aq-update-unified + bounded nh spike (A5, DO-3 allowances)
items.goal: One deploy front door; nh flag with a sunset
items.validation_goal: Approved deploy and intervention succeed; direct privileged activation refused; nh flag cut over or removed within its window

items.name: One remediator (provisional) + health schema (A7, DO-6)
items.goal: Single remediation owner chosen by measurement; add gemini to the probe schema
items.validation_goal: Authorized remediation succeeds and second principal is refused

items.name: Branch-mutation lock and scoped PR branch writers
items.goal: Remove DO-2 bypasses for Gemini and Dependabot paths
items.validation_goal: Concurrent and unauthorized external writers refused; authorized bot regeneration succeeds

items.name: Memory facade + DO-7 (A6)
items.validation_goal: Direct unapproved writer refused at store ingress

items.name: Loop retry-budget convergence
items.goal: One retry budget for six loop families

items.name: Shim map, duplicate ratchet, canon zero-net, PRD three-line header
items.validation_goal: Zero-net-lines test; new PRD missing the header fails

items.name: Experience capture (A8), after its REVISE verdicts are resolved
items.goal: Land experience-capture only once revised and re-reviewed
items.validation_goal: That PRD's journeys on real data
